checklist: STRESS-MATRIX 2 'FAT32 4 GB limit': a 4.1 GB file (sparse, LUMINA_Q2_BIG) exported to a FAT32 disk with 5 GB free. The up-front space check passes; the copy cannot (FAT32 caps a file at 4 GiB − 1). The export must stop with a reason a person understands, leave no temp or partial file, and not report it written. Needs the Q2 driver (docs/release/stress/Q2-storage.md, 'How these run'): the disk images are attached hidden (-nobrowse) by the driver, not by the probe's DiskImages (which show in Finder); the scenario asks for each mount / pull / re-insert with a signal file. Without LUMINA_Q2_DRIVER it SKIPs.
